The 13mm drivers deliver boAt Signature Sound, tailor-made for movies, music, and more. BEAST Mode for Gaming: Level up your game with BEAST Mode, designed for ultra-low 50ms latency. Get perfectly synced audio and visuals for a lag-free, immersive gaming experience. ASAP Charge: Just 10 minutes of charging gives you a whopping 150 minutes of playtime, thanks to ASAP Charge. Power up quickly and get back to your audio adventures!
